value.rationale: The four-letter permutahedron is a canonical highly structured Cayley/Archimedean graph. Its extendible-dimer complex has a natural intrinsic definition. Determining a complete integral mixed-dimensional sphere wedge on a pure 11-dimensional complex is a motivated substantial topology classification and a concrete non-shellability witness, beyond merely counting matchings or Betti numbers. No larger-family theorem is asserted or required.
